purpose: Wire all scaffolded chatbot subsystems into functional end-to-end pipelines: persona prompt injection, memory system, identity drift, rooms architecture with behavioral modes and roleplay scenes, avatar generation with companion info panel, and migration consolidation. Transform the chatbot from a demo with hardcoded defaults into a production companion platform where companion personality, memory, mood, and room context all shape every LLM response.
async_strategy: Phases run sequentially A through F. Within each phase, tasks with disjoint write paths run in parallel waves. Shared fan-in files (chatbot/core/turn.py, chatbot/api/chat.py, chatbot/api/streaming.py, chatbot/api/app.py, react_ui/src/App.tsx, react_ui/src/api/client.ts) are single-owner per wave and serialized via dependency edges.

phases.goal: Wire the persona and system prompt pipeline so that every LLM call includes the companion's character profile (name, backstory, personality sliders, humor style, communication style), the session's identity state (fixed traits, slow drift values, current mood), and the session's relationship config (directness, warmth, initiative). Currently chat.py uses an empty fallback persona, streaming.py hardcodes persona={}, and turn.py's _assemble_persona_prompt never calls CharacterProfile.to_prompt_fragment() or forwards identity state.
phases.async_notes: Wave 1: update chatbot/soul/persona_prompt.py. Wave 2: update chatbot/core/turn.py (depends on wave 1 interface). Wave 3: update chatbot/api/chat.py (depends on wave 2). Wave 4: update chatbot/api/streaming.py (depends on wave 2, serialized after chat.py).
phases.risk_notes: chat.py and streaming.py are the two main request handlers; changes must preserve existing message persistence and streaming behavior. turn.py is a large shared file; edits must be surgical to _assemble_persona_prompt only.

phases.goal: Activate the memory system end-to-end: generate and store pgvector embeddings for every user and assistant message, wire the ContextCompiler into the chat pipeline so relevant past memories are retrieved and included in the LLM context window, configure the consolidation worker with the default LLM provider so background memory consolidation actually runs, wire enqueue_consolidation to trigger after conversations reach a threshold length, and connect Redis as the working memory cache for active conversations.
phases.async_notes: Wave 1: update chatbot/memory/embedding.py (embedding generation function) and chatbot/config.py (Redis connection pool). Disjoint. Wave 2: update chatbot/core/turn.py (ExtractMemoryStep) and chatbot/memory/context_compiler.py (accept db session and vector store). Disjoint. Wave 3: update chatbot/api/chat.py (call embeddings + context compiler). Wave 4: update chatbot/api/streaming.py (same pattern, serialized after chat.py). Wave 5: update chatbot/consolidation/worker.py and chatbot/perf/handlers.py (disjoint from chat endpoints).
phases.risk_notes: chat.py and streaming.py modified again after phase A; phase ordering provides serialization. Redis connection must fail gracefully if Redis is unavailable. Embedding generation should not block the response.

phases.goal: Activate identity drift and mood updates in the chat pipeline. After each assistant response, run identity evolution logic to calculate slow drift updates to personality traits based on conversation patterns, calculate mood updates based on conversation sentiment, persist updated values back to IdentityStateModel, and feed updated mood into the next turn's prompt assembly. Currently evolution.py is only imported for session seeding; it is never called during chat execution.
phases.async_notes: Wave 1: update chatbot/soul/evolution.py (expose calculate_drift and calculate_mood interface). Wave 2: update chatbot/core/turn.py (add post-response identity update step, depends on wave 1). Wave 3: update chatbot/api/chat.py (invoke post-response identity update). Wave 4: update chatbot/api/streaming.py (same pattern, serialized after chat.py).
phases.risk_notes: turn.py is modified again; phase ordering serializes. Evolution calculations should be lightweight and not block the response.

phases.goal: Implement rooms as functional conversation containers with behavioral modes and roleplay scenes. Auto-create a linked session when a room is created. Load room session messages into the chat panel when a room is clicked. Filter messages by room in frontend and backend. Inject room-type-specific system prompt sections (one_on_one_chat: default conversational, roleplay_scene: scene-aware immersive, project: task-oriented structured, emotional_support: empathetic validating reduced-humor, memory_review: memory-surfacing). Apply room-type memory policies. Auto-create default one_on_one_chat room on companion creation. Auto-populate companion_id from active companion. Replace companion_id text input with dropdown. Convert left sidebar from sessions to rooms. Add scene management UI for roleplay rooms. Wire scene state into system prompt via RoleplayEngine. Display active scene status in roleplay chat.
phases.async_notes: Wave 1: update chatbot/rooms/room.py (auto-create session), update chatbot/api/sessions.py (room_id support), create react_ui/src/components/ScenePanel.tsx. All disjoint. Wave 2: update chatbot/api/rooms.py (room-session linking), update react_ui/src/components/RoomSwitcher.tsx (companion dropdown). Disjoint. Wave 3: update chatbot/api/chat.py (room filtering + room-type prompt injection). Wave 4: update chatbot/core/turn.py (RoomContextStep scene injection, depends on wave 3). Wave 5: update chatbot/api/streaming.py (room filtering, serialized after chat.py). Wave 6: update react_ui/src/api/client.ts (room-session API calls). Wave 7: update react_ui/src/App.tsx (room sidebar, scene mount, wire room selection), update react_ui/src/components/ChatInput.tsx (room context). Wave 7 depends on all prior waves.
phases.risk_notes: This phase touches many shared files. chat.py, streaming.py, turn.py, App.tsx, and client.ts are all fan-in points that must be serialized. Phase ordering after A/B/C ensures prior changes are stable.

Auto-generate avatar on companion creation from name, backstory, and description. Store avatar URL on companion record. Add manual upload alternative. Add Regenerate Avatar button in companion editor. Display avatar next to assistant messages. Panel collapses on narrow viewports.

phases.goal: Consolidate broken Alembic migrations into one clean initial migration, remove the create_all() startup race condition, add auto-generated session/room titles from conversation content, and configure voice system TTS/STT providers. Delete all existing broken migration files in alembic/versions/. Generate one clean initial migration from current models. Verify make reset-db && make migrate works on fresh database. Remove or guard create_all() in app startup. Add post-conversation hook for LLM-generated title. Wire TTS_API_KEY and STT_API_KEY env vars into voice adapters.

Update chatbot/voice/tts.py and chatbot/voice/stt.py (wire API keys). Update .env.example. All disjoint. Wave 2: update chatbot/api/chat.py (auto-title generation). Wave 3: update chatbot/api/streaming.py (auto-title, serialized after chat.py).
